## Services

- [Emergency Plumbing](/services/emergency-plumbing/): burst and frozen pipes, active leaks, sewer backups, no heat. 60–90 min typical arrival in Regina.
- [Drain Cleaning](/services/drain-cleaning/): snaking, hydro-jetting, camera inspection. Root intrusion in older clay laterals is the common Regina cause.
- [Water Heater Repair & Replacement](/services/water-heater-repair/): tank and tankless repair, replacement and sizing. Hard Regina water shortens tank life to 8–12 years.
- [Furnace & Heating](/services/furnace-heating/): no-heat diagnosis, igniter and flame sensor replacement, high-efficiency replacement, annual service.
- [Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing](/services/bathroom-kitchen-plumbing/): fixture installation, renovation rough-ins, drain relocation.
- [Sump Pumps & Backwater Valves](/services/sump-pumps-backwater-valves/): flood protection, battery backup, backwater valve installation.

## Service areas

- [Regina](/service-areas/regina/): full city coverage, ~20 min from base.
- [White City](/service-areas/white-city/): including Emerald Park, ~25 min.
- [Pilot Butte](/service-areas/pilot-butte/): ~25 min.
- [Lumsden](/service-areas/lumsden/): Qu'Appelle Valley, ~30 min. Spring flood protection priority.
- [Balgonie](/service-areas/balgonie/): ~30 min via Highway 1.
